entities.name: UniProt E1BPQ1 FOXO1
observations: Exact 624-aa sequence match to reviewed Bos taurus forkhead box protein O1 (FOXO1).
FOXO1 is a sequence-specific transcription factor; its activity and nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling are regulated by insulin/AKT signaling and stress-associated inputs.
Sequence-derived estimates: 66.36 kDa, pI 6.60, GRAVY -0.551, instability index 60.14; estimates do not account for modifications.
Pfam scan identified Forkhead PF00250 (132–213), FOXO_KIX_bdg PF16675 (393–473), and FOXO-TAD PF16676 (564–603).
